transition: binary undirected adjacency, row-normalized in float64; dangling rows receive a self-loop
convergence: L1 norm of consecutive distributions <= tolerance; failed convergence yields no Candidate scores
score: mean stationary mass at all retained drug Targets; descending score then ascending ChEMBL ID
scope: largest connected component of each graph; select top 50 evidence_only Disease Targets before graph filtering
comparisons: all unordered method pairs, reported as second minus first with paired Disease bootstrap intervals
classification: retrospective source-record relationship recovery; jury-development-excluded, not a prospective or unseen clinical holdout
